title: MondayMotivator 03 March: 5,127 protypes later ...
html:
Perseverance is the hard work you do after you get tired of doing the hard work you already did. Newt Gingrich

Don't give up! Whatever you are doing don't stop now. Your next break-through, solution or success could be just around the corner.

I was reading Idealog recently and there was an article about James Dyson. 5,127 prototypes later the world's first bagless vacuum cleaner was a reality.

That's right - five thousand, one hundred and twenty six prototypes.

Where would you have stopped? Dyson has achieved sales of over NZD $7 Billion worldwide because he kept going until he found the solution.

From personal experience I have realised that perseverance does work. It took me five years to develop an email marketing system for the Real Estate industry that offered personalisation, consistency for the companies and affordability for the agents. And it's finally a great success.

Don't give up today, you will always find your solution eventually.
